what: Layer 45 (page 46) read on 30 October 2026 against a second null: 2,048 controls mixed from the layer's own write directions (census.CONTROL_KINDS 'columns', seed 11), each unit(sum_n g_n u_n) with g isotropic over the 21,504 neurons and u_n = unit(w_post * W_down[:, n]). The controls were taken alone on the home 5090 (census_run.py --neurons none --control-kind columns, the layer run's settings otherwise: --batch 64 --max-new 48 --unpacker compiled) and joined to the layer run's 21,504 neurons (census_tools.py join), whose answers were not written again. The joined run was ranked by the census's own code and read on the CPU with the trial's reader, unchanged, its hashes checked (read.sh).

runs.controls: atlas_data/census/nulls/L45-break_rel-columns-controls.* (gitignored): 49,158 answers (2,048 controls x 24 + 6 unpushed), begun 09:32 CDT. A GPU watchdog stopped it at 10:34 with 41,664 written (kernel: 'RC watchdog: GPU is probably locked', Xid 8, against this process, as a kernel build took the load from 5 to 22); the same command, rerun at 10:39, wrote the other 7,494 by 10:50. About 73 minutes of writing at 11.1-11.2 answers a second (the logs' own lines), in two sittings of 62 and 12 minutes with the model's load
runs.joined: atlas_data/census/nulls/L45-break_rel-columns.* (gitignored): 565,254 answers, the six unpushed the same in both runs bit for bit (checked by the join). Its meta records three runtime classes (mixed_runtime): the layer run at 5fa58c6, the controls at 4edc4af with a clean tree, then 4edc4af with this folder and ARCHITECTURE.md uncommitted after the resume. Nothing the answers run differs between the last two; between 5fa58c6 and 4edc4af backend/census.py (its reading, the control draw and the join), atlas.py and the scientist's prompt and tools changed, and the six unpushed answers agree bit for bit across them
runs.mixes_as_neurons: atlas_data/census/nulls/L45-mixes-as-neurons.* (gitignored): the 2,048 columns controls standing where neurons stand, against the layer run's 2,048 isotropic controls (mixes_as_neurons.py)

the_null_built: On the weights, before the run (check_census.py, and the prototype): the mixes take the neurons' spread. Their share on the layer's top 100 write directions is 5.18% (the neurons' 5.31%, an isotropic direction's 2.22%), their read gain 1.004 of the neurons' (isotropic 1.02), their largest unembedding z 4.62 (neurons 4.75, isotropic 4.60). They match the neurons' second moment on average, not each neuron's

verdict.48: every gate passes against the columns controls: lead 0.7115 (against isotropic 0.7126; bar 0.60); beyond text survival 0.7344 (0.7237; 0.58); words picked on one half and scored on the other 0.6682 and 0.6649 (0.6795 and 0.6714; 0.57); the new questions alone 0.6509 (0.6619; 0.56); null split 0.4925, read gain 1.006, every answer present, the units file ranks as read (0.0005)
verdict.pm1_alone: the +-1 answers alone clear every bar: 0.7227, 0.7311, 0.6779 and 0.6715, 0.6524 (against isotropic 0.7144, 0.7285, 0.6731 and 0.6651, 0.6494); G5b fails by construction, as before
verdict.counts_48: 2,358 of 21,504 neurons above every control (11.0%; 2,357 by the census's rank, one sitting within the reader's 0.0005 of the largest control), about 10.5 by chance; 6,746 with q <= 0.05; 5,237 named, 3,217 by halves; the halves' ranks agree at 0.479 among neurons, 0.097 among controls

the_mixes_as_neurons: Against the isotropic controls the mixes read as controls: lead 0.5023, beyond text survival 0.4812, replication 0.5168 and 0.5150, the new questions alone 0.5126, read gain 1.016. None beats every isotropic control (1.0 by chance), none reaches q <= 0.05, none is named; 7 have p <= 0.05 on both halves (5.1 by chance). As far as the trial's reader can tell, the two kinds of control are one null

the_two_nulls.the_largest: the isotropic null's largest is one control, 609, whose +-1 answers turn to Indonesian (yang, adalah, berikut, berbagai, dan): words no other control writes, so its mass, 24.04, stands 10.5 above that null's next at +-1. The columns null's largest is a loop of s's at +-2 (438, 22.07); at +-1 its largest is 14.42 (30: little, bridge, very, map). One draw in 2,048 does not say whether a mix can turn the language too
the_two_nulls.what_moves: the counts that rest on the largest control move with it: neurons above every control 1,580 against isotropic, 2,357 against columns (every one of the 1,580 among them); at +-1 alone 1,032 and 6,522. The counts that rest on the bulk move little: q <= 0.05 6,308 and 6,746 (6,305 in both), named 5,123 and 5,237 (5,052 in both). The neurons' masses agree at a Spearman of 0.9985 and their p at 0.9971; of the top 20 by mass all 20 are the same, of the top 100, 97, of the top 1,000, 980

collapse_rule: with these controls the rule again needs 20 to hold a word, and holds 14 as the isotropic controls do: idea, own, owns, rest, same, thought and their joins in both; single and dependingthought here, sss and the fivefold thought there. With their joins it hides 297 words (isotropic 409); of the 2,357 above every control 1,682 keep a description on the map
text: the mixes' text survives as the isotropic controls' does: at +-1 they lose 0.003 of their distinct-4 to the unpushed answer (isotropic 0.004, neurons 0.04); at +-2 0.79-0.80, as every kind does
what_it_shows: The neurons' lead is not the layer's write subspace. A random mix of the layer's own write directions, spread as they are, reads like a random direction, and the neurons stand above it by the same margin (lead 0.71 either way). What stands out is a single neuron's own direction, not the space the layer writes in, nor that space's spread
what_it_does_not_show: The mixes are dense: each weighs all 21,504 directions, so by the central limit each is near-Gaussian in the layer's covariance. They share the neurons' second moment, not anything beyond it, such as a neuron's sparsity or a heavy tail toward a few words. A mix of a few neurons would ask how many it takes to lose the lead. Not built
The neurons were not asked again: their 21,504 answers are the layer run's. The only test of the neurons themselves is still inside the run, the halves (which agree at 0.48, controls 0.10)
The counts above every control rest on one control each, as the Indonesian one shows: read the gates and the q's, not those counts, when two nulls are set side by side
A retest of the strongest still needs a design whose questions no screen asked
